title: Finish the Jev adapter and injectable client configuration
description:
## Scope

Complete the System One wrapper with an explicit model identifier, structured target and examples, fixed task wording, safe credential loading, and raw response metadata. Reuse the current injected-client path and verified Few-Shot-Jev request format.

## Definition of done

Fake-client conformance specs assert identical questions across context sizes, isolated target fields, faithful probability parsing, and no credentials or article text in persisted metadata.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Finish the Jev adapter and injectable client configuration
  Scenario: Required observable behavior
    Given the same task and target are classified with empty and nonempty context
    When the fake Jev client records both requests
    Then only the examples field changes and the target is the only item classified
```
